originalAcquisition.sampleMount: composition-spread thin-film strip mounted to a hotplate with silver paste
originalAcquisition.sequence: All compositions measured isothermally before temperature ramping to avoid hysteresis.

currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.relevance: Its certified Cu K-alpha response begins at 22 degrees two-theta, overlapping part of the 18-37.2 degree survey window.
currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.restriction: A disc measured in its certified powder-diffraction use does not automatically reproduce the fixed-14-degree thin-film geometry.

currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.role: thin single-crystal HRXRD angle and alignment candidate
currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.form: Si(100) block with SiGe epitaxial layer
currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.relevance: Provides certified reflection/transmission quantities and surface-to-crystal-plane alignment for HRXRD.
currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.restriction: Its certified HRXRD geometries are not the original fixed-incidence combinatorial survey geometry.

currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.relevance: Provides a traceable powder-diffraction angular and profile reference.
currentOfficialReferenceCandidates.restriction: Powder form and mounting differ from the thin-film hotplate measurement and require a separate compatibility scan.

bridgeDesign.traceableAnchor: Measure a selected SRM only in the geometry and use prescribed by its current certificate.
bridgeDesign.sameGeometryTransferMonitor: Measure a sealed stable transfer artifact in the exact specimen geometry, incident angle, detector window, exposure, and mounting used for VO2 acquisitions.
bridgeDesign.bridgeScan: At session start and checkpoint, acquire the traceable anchor and transfer monitor without intervening alignment changes beyond a recorded configuration transition; estimate the transition uncertainty separately.

decision: Do not preregister SRM 640f, 1976c, or 2000 as geometry-compatible merely because it is an X-ray diffraction standard. Preserve the 24 calibration-frame budget as roles: sixteen same-geometry transfer-monitor frames and eight traceable-anchor frames. Select the actual artifacts only after certificate, angular-window, mounting, detector, and configuration-transition compatibility are documented for the chosen instrument.
failureConditions: No certified reflection lies in a usable detector window for the selected anchor configuration.
The transfer artifact changes under the session temperature or exposure history.
Changing between anchor and specimen geometry introduces an unrecorded alignment step.
The bridge uncertainty is as large as the frontier-control contrast.
Calibration choices are changed after specimen outcomes are inspected.
